evaluate_temporal_semantic_model.description: Evaluate the performance of a temporal model combined with an external semantic model on a given benchmark dataset using score fusion or ranking fusion.

model_name.description: Name of the temporal model to evaluate.

external_model_name.description: Name of the external sentence transformer model to use for fusion.

model_path.description: Path to the pre-trained temporal semantic model.

batch_size.description: Number of samples per evaluation batch.

max_seq_len.description: Maximum sequence length for model input.

benchmark_file_path.description: Path to the benchmark JSON file containing questions, paragraphs, and answers.

eval_id.description: Unique identifier for the evaluation run, used in output file naming.

top_k.description: Number of top predictions to consider when computing metrics.

metric.description: Name of the metric to compute (e.g., 'precision', 'recall', 'f1').

skip.description: If true, skip running the models and use existing similarity files.

use_ranking.description: If true, use Borda count ranking fusion; otherwise use score normalization and weighted fusion.

alpha.description: Weight parameter for score fusion (temporal weight), where external weight is (1-alpha). Temporal gets weight 'alpha', external gets weight '(1-alpha)' but is multiplied by 2 in the code.

use_all_paragraphs.description: If true, use all unique paragraphs from the benchmark for each question; otherwise use only the paragraphs associated with each question.

reference_date.description: Reference date used for temporal embeddings.

temporal_similarities_path.description: Path pattern for temporal model similarity output files.

semantic_similarities_path.description: Path pattern for external model similarity output files.

temporal_cache_path.description: Path pattern for temporal model embedding cache files.

semantic_cache_path.description: Path pattern for external model embedding cache files.
